objective: Gather comparable evidence about original component durability, known failure mechanisms, supply of exact repair parts, repairability, and total restoration costs before any Saab ranking.

boundaries.present_scoped_universe: US compiled 110 automatic/FWD/nonconvertible 9-3 and 9-5 configuration groups, MY1998–2011; third-party reported production, not certified exhaustive.
boundaries.candidate_policy: Research universe is NOT proof all Saab models are eligible; manuals, convertibles, XWD/AWD, Canadian-only combinations, and 9-2X/9-7X/9-4X are not represented by the 110-row audit. Preserve any prior buying filters; ask owner whether to broaden actual tier comparison universe rather than silently rank excluded cars.
boundaries.no_ranking_until: Comparable evidence coverage, named omissions, agreed tier boundaries and comparison universe; existing Phase 0 A/B/C gates remain unchanged.
non_assumptions: A WIS repair procedure or TSB proves a failure happened
Number of TSBs or complaint reports is a frequency rate
Production volume equals at-risk fleet exposure in 2026
An aftermarket catalog match is a manufacturer-approved part interchange
A seller listing proves purchase fulfilment
Low source coverage means good original reliability
More research records mean worse or better reliability
An original EU or UK failure distribution transfers directly to US automatic FWD
A year/platform alone proves same engine, ECU, gearbox, radiator or structural failure mode

dimensions.name: Original component durability
dimensions.common_trap: Manufacturer issued a service bulletin, so all vehicles in those years fail.

dimensions.name: Parts availability and substitution
dimensions.common_trap: Part appears in several catalogues, so it is in stock or fits any Saab.

dimensions.name: Known model/powertrain failures
dimensions.common_trap: A prominent forum complaint is representative of every car or even a verified failure.

dimensions.name: Repairability and ownership repair economics
dimensions.common_trap: Cheap component or historic factory warranty time makes the complete repair cheap.

system_inventory.name: Engine internals, oil delivery, PCV and sludge
Timing drive, valve train and intake valves
Turbocharger, oil feed, charge air and boost controls
Body shell, subframe, structural corrosion and safety mounts
Brake friction, hydraulics, ABS/ESC, lines and parking brake
Cooling, radiator/heat exchangers, fans and related ATF cooling
Fuel system, catalyst, OBD emissions and evaporative controls
ECUs, ignition, keys, anti-theft, software and programming
Alternator, starter, harnesses, connectors and grounds

evidence_classes.factory_source: Source establishes specified design, part identity, factory corrective action or diagnostic method only; not population frequency.
evidence_classes.regulator_campaign: Safety recall/campaign population and remedies; no proof individual vehicle suffered the defect or has been repaired.
evidence_classes.owner_complaint: Self-selected allegation, possibly incomplete or duplicate; investigation lead only; never a failure rate by itself.
evidence_classes.inspection_statistic: Observed test pass/fail among tested surviving vehicles, with category and mileage/age/location/season handling; not powertrain lifetime reliability.
evidence_classes.warranty_or_fleet: Frequency rate only if numerator, true eligible at-risk denominator/exposure, observation interval and ascertainment/maintenance bias are documented.
evidence_classes.supplier_catalogue: Supplier fitment/cross-reference/advertised stock claim, not OEM-approved supersession, current fulfilled sale or durability.
evidence_classes.mechanic_case_study: Diagnostic or repair-path evidence, not necessarily prevalence.
evidence_classes.owner_forum: Qualitative lead requiring corroboration; not prevalence evidence.

quantitative_observation_requirements.numerator: Verified distinct events with repeat repairs distinguished from additional affected vehicles.
quantitative_observation_requirements.denominator: At-risk population for exact platform/year/powertrain/market/installed revision. Production totals alone are NOT units remaining in-service over observation window.
quantitative_observation_requirements.exposure: Observation years, mileage distribution, vehicle age, location/climate, usage, maintenance and entry/exit/censoring where possible.
quantitative_observation_requirements.selection_bias: Self-selection, repair-shop specialization, scrap/survivor bias, warranty eligibility and recall publicity.
quantitative_observation_requirements.uncertainty: Sample count, sampling design, plausible confidence interval and unresolved missingness; if unsupported leave frequency null.
quantitative_observation_requirements.transferable_market_rule: US/Canada vs UK vs EU evidence can be used as a mechanism lead, but distinct market, emissions, engine, rust climate and inspection regimes block naive pooled rates.

source_pipeline.publisher: U.S. National Highway Traffic Safety Administration
source_pipeline.data: ODI complaints by model year/make/model, including component and reporting date
source_pipeline.use: Discover alleged safety defects; de-duplicate ODI IDs and cross-check investigations/TSBs; counts not comparable failure rates.

source_pipeline.publisher: U.S. National Highway Traffic Safety Administration
source_pipeline.data: Manufacturer recall reports and investigation populations
source_pipeline.use: Verify affected build ranges and safety remedies; recall count not a vehicle reliability score.

source_pipeline.publisher: U.S. National Highway Traffic Safety Administration
source_pipeline.use: Crosscheck vehicle identity where manufacturer submission supports the model year; may not reveal installed replaced hardware or Saab EPC part chain.

source_pipeline.publisher: UK Driver and Vehicle Standards Agency
source_pipeline.data: Anonymized MOT inspection tests, odometer and defect codes since 2005
source_pipeline.use: Compare inspected survivors' corrosion/brakes/suspension defects controlling age, mileage, model-year and UK weather; not North American mechanical powertrain failure probability.

source_pipeline.publisher: Saab Parts / Hedin manufacturer support channel
source_pipeline.data: VIN-filtered OEM parts and official directed replacements
source_pipeline.use: Required for qualified original assembly and actual directed supersession. Access may be licensed; unavailable manufacturer approval must remain unresolved.

source_pipeline.data: Dated exact-SKU offers, fulfilment, stock, warranty and delivered pricing
source_pipeline.use: Record actual market-specific offers with timestamps, validate physical fit separately, and compare landed costs for identical scope; historical listings are nonlive.

readiness_requirements.candidate_coverage: Every eligible configuration must have source-backed identity fields, and explicitly listed exclusions must not be silently ranked.
readiness_requirements.comparable_systems: Every critical system assessed with the same collection template for all comparable cohorts; each missing area has a named gap and attempted source outcome.
readiness_requirements.design_revision_control: Original part and later factory revisions must be distinguished when sourced; neither late fix nor original failure imputed to all years.
readiness_requirements.failure_rate_disclosure: A mechanism may be marked documented while its population frequency stays unknown. Rate claims require denominator and exposure; no fake 0% for unreported failures.
readiness_requirements.real_parts_quote: Exact eligible replacement has checked application, dated deliverability, vendor diversity/warranty, ancillary tools/programming and total-cost estimation.
readiness_requirements.tier_gate: No rank score, grade, winner, priority model or year preference until comparison-universe and transparent weighting discussion, sufficient comparable evidence, and residual confidence/uncertainty disclosure.
readiness_requirements.weighting: Not set. Availability, intrinsic original reliability, severe failures and repairability stay separate until user approves tradeoff weights.

safe_current_statement: Current database has 110 source-derived U.S. automatic/FWD/nonconvertible groups with diagnostic and tooling research leads. Existing feasibility audit explicitly reports 0 quantified failure rates, 0 verified repair prices, and 0 approved part interchanges, which blocks a high-confidence tier.
